Knowledge recorded by Shinnecock elders in 2014

Wild strawberries

Small wild strawberries are remembered through the bodily work of gathering near the ground and the timing of the Strawberry Moon. The catalogue connects the fruit with the heart and a Shinnecock story of Strawberry Woman.1

Places named in the catalogue

Long Island; Shinnecock territories.1

Page references

The Shinnecock Environmental Department compiled this catalogue from elders’ memories and community resource knowledge in 2014. Food and medicine appear here as historical knowledge; safe identification and treatment require current guidance.

Shinnecock Environmental Department, Natural Resources Identified by Shinnecock Elders, April 4, 2014, PDF p. 20. Page numbers count the cover as PDF page 1.
